purpose: Freeze the recipe and the gates before any training, so PAPER_EVAL can never select the epoch, the mixing fraction, or the label filter.
question: With the exposure budget held identical to V1-V5, does replacing pseudo-labels with real manual GT beat source-only R0 on keypoint localisation?

inherits_unchanged.note: Not one field is re-tuned. The single change is the SOURCE OF THE LABELS in the 1440 non-synthetic slots.

recipe.checkpoint_selection: last.pt — fixed, never selected on any metric

training_labels.slot_fill_rule: deterministic round-robin over the accepted frame list sorted by (session, stem), with replacement, until 1440 slots are filled
training_labels.eligibility_note: Frames are admitted only after the keypoint-index convention is verified. If USABLE_AS_TRAINING_LABELS = NO, the experiment is not run.

label_conversion.format: 0 cx cy w h then 9 triples (x y v), all normalised
label_conversion.box_rule: bounding box of the visible keypoints after clipping to the image, matching the synthetic convention
label_conversion.box_rule_evidence: verified on 400 random synthetic labels from g38_legacy_v1v2_p0_tex20k: 400/400 agree within 2e-3
label_conversion.off_screen_corner_rationale: The synthetic training convention contains zero keypoints outside [0,1] (measured: 0/400 labels). The belief-map head cannot place a peak outside the decoded grid, so an off-image coordinate is not a learnable target, and clipping it would teach a wrong location. Marking v=0 keeps the label inside the convention the model was pretrained under.
label_conversion.off_screen_scale: 87 of 3212 corners (2.7 percent) across 46 of 402 frames
label_conversion.loss: standard PoseLoss26 as in V1 and V2, not the V3 true-ignore loss
label_conversion.loss_rationale: Real GT is fully known, so no ignore semantics are needed; using the standard loss keeps the arm comparable to V1/V2 rather than introducing a second change.

preflight_contract_checks.check: ultralytics does not silently clip or drop keypoints marked v=0 in a way that alters the supervised coordinates
the 1440 synthetic replay entries are byte-identical to the V1-V5 replay subset (membership sha256 match)
no accepted real image hashes to any PAPER_EVAL image

leakage_evidence.method: sha256 over raw image bytes, PAPER_EVAL 319 versus every live_capture_gt image
leakage_evidence.coverage_note: All 402 candidate frames were hashed, including the 290 kimjihoon frames whose images live outside the annotation folder. An earlier pass covered only the 112 co-located images; that gap was closed before any training.
independent_separations: object type: training is plastic_standard_110x110x15 only; PAPER_EVAL wood_183705/wood_184309 are wood
resolution and intrinsics: training 640x480 CALIBRATED realsense factory; PAPER_EVAL wood sessions 1280x720 SENSOR_PROFILE_SCALED legacy_import
repository contract: live_capture_gt objects[0].split == 'train'; PAPER_EVAL comes from objects[0].split == 'eval'

evaluation.identical_to: V1, V2, V3, V4, V5 and FAST teacher probes
evaluation.paired_rule: compare R0 and REAL_FT on the same supervised keypoints only; coverage reported separately
evaluation.material_note: Training labels are 100% plastic, so the wood half is cross-object generalisation and must never be merged into a single headline number.

gates.on_fail: REAL_FT_V1 = FAILED; conclusion is that label quality is not the bottleneck

gates.note: the tail is where V1-V5 and all three FAST teachers died

statistics.unresolved_label: NOT_STATISTICALLY_RESOLVED when the interval contains zero
statistics.note: The point-estimate gate decides PASS/FAIL as registered; the interval is reported alongside and never overrides it.

conditional_second_arm.name: REAL_IMG_PSEUDO_CONTROL
conditional_second_arm.design: identical exposure, identical 402 real images, labels replaced by R0's own predictions
conditional_second_arm.question: separates the effect of seeing real images from the effect of correct human labels
conditional_second_arm.why_conditional: if G1 fails there is no effect to attribute

forbidden: tuning epochs, lr, mixing fraction, or any threshold on PAPER_EVAL results
selecting a checkpoint other than last.pt
putting any PAPER_EVAL frame into training or validation
designing REAL_FT_V2 against the same PAPER_EVAL after a failure
reporting plastic and wood merged into one headline localisation number
modifying any V1-V5 or FAST teacher artefact
external_prior_art_note: Literature on real-label efficiency for synthetic-to-real keypoint transfer was not reviewed. The design comes entirely from in-repository measurement.
